title: A Short and Easy Method of Prayer
author: Madame Guyon
description: Madame Guyon describes a practice of inward prayer through recollection, quiet attention and trust. This is the historical Thomas Digby Brooke rendering.
editionNote: 1775 edition. ECCO scan (imprint garbled in OCR). Edition credit: Thomas Digby Brooke. The EPUB is a facsimile with page images.
